# H3 Ripple — Models & setup

Use a current ComfyUI version and install [ComfyUI-WepeNerd](https://github.com/WepeNerd/ComfyUI-WepeNerd). Download the eight files below; folders are relative to your ComfyUI directory. Both Qwen editor branches use the same three files, so download each only once.

## Video editing — MiniMax H3 + Ripple

### H3 FL2VA diffusion model · [Download](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)

`minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`

Save in `models/diffusion_models/`.

### H3 Turbo 4-step LoRA · [Download](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo/resolve/main/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.3_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors)

`minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.3_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors`

Save in `models/loras/H3/`.

### H3 Ripple LoRA · [Model page](https://huggingface.co/WepeNerd/H3_Ripple)

`minimax_H3_Ripple-v1.safetensors`

Save in `models/loras/H3/`.

### H3 text encoder · [Download](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)

`qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors`

Save in `models/text_encoders/`.

### H3 video VAE · [Download](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)

`minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors`

Save in `models/vae/`.

## Anchor image editing — Qwen Image 2.1

### Qwen Image 2.1 diffusion model · [Download](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/diffusion_models/qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors)

`qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors`

Save in `models/diffusion_models/`.

### Qwen Image text encoder · [Download](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors)

`qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors`

Save in `models/text_encoders/`.

### Qwen Image 2.1 VAE · [Download](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/main/vae/qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors)

`qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors`

Save in `models/vae/`.

## Setup & saved settings

Refresh the model lists or restart ComfyUI after copying the files, then select them in the loaders. If the published Ripple download has a different filename, select that file in the Ripple LoRA loader.

- **H3:** Turbo LoRA enabled; **4 steps · Euler · simple · CFG 1**. Both LoRA strengths are **1.0**. CLIP type: **minimax**.
- **Qwen:** **25 steps · Euler · simple · CFG 1** in both branches. CLIP type: **qwen_image**. Encoder resolution: **0**. Keep both sampler seeds fixed for repeatable edits.

## Using this workflow

Choose the video, shot and two anchor markers in Ripple Clip. Write the change in each anchor's edit instruction and keep the two edits consistent. Each Qwen branch edits its anchor and feeds the result into Ripple Apply. Anchor sockets follow marker IDs, even when the markers cross on the timeline.

**Ripple Output is enabled in this file:** queuing runs the local Qwen edits and the H3 video render. The optional API editing nodes are bypassed and are not needed for the local workflow.
